title: Dead Air Atlas
description: An original supernatural co-op mystery in real mapped streets. Search by town or location name to generate a bounded OSM district; recover three impossible recordings by matching radio channels and holding a light, then reconnect a water tower to restore fast travel. Shared notebook, inventory, HP/clarity, points, cooldowns, saves, a larger touch joystick with outer-ring sprint, Run lock, one-tap next-objective routing, and tap-to-follow street routes. Up to four peers share the host atlas; the party moves between districts together through towers or district edges. Version 0.2 starts the reproducible Rhinelander case beside a mapped water tower. Original code/art CC0; OSM map data ODbL; Trystero/Three.js MIT. Procedural façades, not imagery. Live queries use a cached map service and an OpenFreeMap vector fallback; vector maps retain additional attribution and may omit water-tower POIs.

title: Dead Air Atlas: editable game and systems source kit
description: Portable complete source starter: playable town-name-based co-op mystery with mobile sprint controls, eight original reusable CC0 logic modules plus a bundled vector decoder with BSD/ISC notices, tower GLB/generator, existing shared game systems, pinned catalog props/textures, attributed OSM snapshot, map-service source, rebuild scripts and detailed composition guide. Original code/art CC0, maps ODbL, transport MIT. Run node prepare.mjs, serve the folder and edit with your agent. Includes full license separation. The archive is mixed-license, not wholly CC0.
